arxiv-2012-05358.title: Dark Matter as gravitational solitons in the weak field limit
arxiv-2012-05358.creator: Torsten Asselmeyer-Maluga, Jerzy Król
arxiv-2012-05358.description: Abstract In this paper, we will describe the idea that dark matter partly consists of gravitational solitons (gravisolitons). The corresponding solution is valid for weak gravitational fields (weak field limit) with respect to a background metric. The stability of this soliton is connected with the existence of a special foliation and amazingly with the smoothness properties of spacetime.

arxiv-2106-07974.title: On Soliton Resolution for a Lattice Thanks: Research supported in part by grant 10331/2019 at the University of Crete.
arxiv-2106-07974.creator: Nicholas Hatzizisis †, Spyridon Kamvissis ‡
arxiv-2106-07974.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Nicholas Hatzizisis †, Spyridon Kamvissis ‡. The soliton resolution conjecture for evolution PDEs of dispersive type states (vaguely) that generic initial data of finite energy give rise asymptotically to a set of receding solitons and a decaying background radiation.

arxiv-2108-07604.title: A Textbook Case of Pentagram Rigidity
arxiv-2108-07604.creator: Richard Evan Schwartz
arxiv-2108-07604.description: Abstract In this paper I will explain a rigidity conjecture that intertwines the deep diagonal pentagram maps and Poncelet polygons. I will also establish a simple case of the conjecture, the one involving the 3 3 -diagonal map on a convex 8 8 -gon with 4 4 -fold rotational symmetry.

arxiv-2409-11445.title: Jailbreaking Large Language Models with Symbolic Mathematics
arxiv-2409-11445.creator: Emet Bethany, Mazal Bethany, Juan Arturo Nolazco Flores, Sumit Kumar Jha, Peyman Najafirad
arxiv-2409-11445.description: Abstract Recent advancements in AI safety have led to increased efforts in training and red-teaming large language models (LLMs) to mitigate unsafe content generation. However, these safety mechanisms may not be comprehensive, leaving potential vulnerabilities unexplored. This paper introduces MathPrompt, a novel jailbreaking technique that exploits LLMs’ advanced capabilities in symbolic mathematics to bypass their safety mechanisms.

arxiv-2412-10204.title: Unbalanced Zarankiewicz problem for bipartite subdivisions with applications to incidence geometry
arxiv-2412-10204.creator: Lili Ködmön, Anqi Li, Ji Zeng
arxiv-2412-10204.description: Abstract For a bipartite graph H H , its linear threshold is the smallest real number σ \sigma such that every bipartite graph G = ( U ⊔ V , E ) G=(U\sqcup V,E) with unbalanced parts | V | ≳ | U | σ |V|\gtrsim|U|^{\sigma} and without a copy of H H must have a linear number of edges

arxiv-2606-05852.title: UniVoice: A Unified Model for Speech and Singing Voice Generation
arxiv-2606-05852.creator: Junjie Zheng, Huixin Xue, Shihong Ren, Chaofan Ding, Hao Liu, Zihao Chen

pmc-10614104.title: Cri-Du-Chat Syndrome Associated With Meningomyelocele: A Case Report
pmc-10614104.creator: Fatimah A Alabbad, Roqaia Alali, Mohammed Alquraini, Zahra M Alghannam, Mohammed B Alabdullah, Haider H AlMousa
pmc-10614104.description: Cri-du-chat syndrome (CdCS) is a rare genetic disorder in which the short arm of chromosome 5 is deleted. This report aims to highlight a rare association with the syndrome. We present a preterm male delivered at 35 weeks gestation with an antenatal diagnosis of meningomyelocele. The patient's clinical examination revealed ruptured lumbosacral meningomyelocele, lower limb hypotonia, and hyporeflexia.

pmc-11390836.title: The Impact of Perceived Community Services for the Elderly on Self-Rated Health: An Analysis Utilizing a Mediated Latent Growth Model
pmc-11390836.creator: Maomin Jiang, Yisong Yao, Xiaoqian Xia, Yang Kong, Nan Zhang
pmc-11390836.description: BackgroundThis study aims to investigate the relationship between older adults’ perceived community services for the elderly (PCSE), life satisfaction (LS), and self-rated health (SRH).MethodsData from four rounds of the Chinese Longitudinal Healthy Longevity Survey (CLHLS) from 2008 to 2018 were used. A total of 2454 older adults were obtained.

pmc-11436679.title: European Union crop map 2022: Earth observation’s 10-meter dive into Europe’s crop tapestry
pmc-11436679.creator: Babak Ghassemi, Emma Izquierdo-Verdiguier, Astrid Verhegghen, Momchil Yordanov, Guido Lemoine, Álvaro Moreno Martínez, Davide De Marchi, Marijn van der Velde, Francesco Vuolo, Raphaël d’Andrimont
pmc-11436679.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). To provide the information needed for a detailed monitoring of crop types across the European Union (EU), we present an advanced 10-metre resolution map for the EU and Ukraine with 19 crop types for 2022, updating the 2018 version. Using Earth Observation (EO) and in-situ data from Eurostat’s Land Use and Coverage Area Frame Survey (LUCAS) 2022, the methodology included 134,684 LUCAS Copernicus polygons, Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 satellite imagery, land surface temperature and a digital elevation model.

pmc-11440807.title: Impact of NHI copayment adjustments on healthcare seeking behavior: the mediating role of health facility identification
pmc-11440807.creator: Liang-Hsi Kung, Chih-Ming Kung, Chien Chih Chen, Yu-Hua Yan
pmc-11440807.description: ObjectiveThis study investigates the impact of healthcare consumers’ involvement, price perception, and attitude toward National Health Insurance (NHI) copayment adjustments on their healthcare-seeking behavior, focusing on the mediating role of health facility identification.MethodsA questionnaire survey was conducted among outpatient customers in Taiwan from October 2023 to March 2024, resulting in 746 valid responses.

pmc-11486878.title: Exploring the interaction mechanisms between cervical carcinoma in situ and antibody-mediated immune responses through Mendelian randomization analysis
pmc-11486878.creator: Junfei Li, Lihuang He, Qun He, Kaihong Xie, Hui Xie
pmc-11486878.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). ObjectiveThis study aims to investigate the causal relationship between cervical carcinoma in situ and antibody-mediated immune responses, providing a scientific basis for the prevention and treatment of cervical carcinoma in situ.MethodsA bidirectional Mendelian Randomization (MR) approach was utilized, leveraging two Genome-Wide Association Studies (GWAS) related to cervical carcinoma in situ and antibody-mediated immune responses to collect Single Nucleotide Polymorphism (SNP) data. Multiple statistical methods, including the inverse-variance weighted (IVW) method, MR-Egger regression, weighted median, and weighted mode, were utilized.

pmc-11618365.title: Models optimized for real-world tasks reveal the task-dependent necessity of precise temporal coding in hearing
pmc-11618365.creator: Mark R Saddler, Josh H McDermott
pmc-11618365.description: Neurons encode information in the timing of their spikes in addition to their firing rates. Spike timing is particularly precise in the auditory nerve, where action potentials phase lock to sound with sub-millisecond precision, but its behavioral relevance remains uncertain.

pmc-11641958.title: Prolonged Taping with Exercise Therapy for Patellofemoral Pain in Adults: A Systematic Review and Single-Arm Meta-Analysis
pmc-11641958.creator: Christian A. Than, Maamoun Adra, Tom J. Curtis, Yasmine J. Khair, Hugh Milchem, Sum-Yu C. Lee, Goktug Şanli, Karen Smayra, Hayato Nakanishi, Zaher Dannawi, Belinda R. Beck
pmc-11641958.description: Purpose: To investigate the effects of prolonged taping on patellofemoral pain (PFP). Methods: A literature search of PubMed, EMBASE (Elsevier), CiNAHL, Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials, Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews, Scopus, and Web of Science was conducted from database inception to 28 June 2024.

pmc-11651964.title: Deep learning-based reconstruction: a reliability assessment in preoperative magnetic resonance imaging for primary rectal cancer
pmc-11651964.creator: Weiming Feng, Lan Zhu, Yihan Xia, Jingwen Tan, Jiankun Dai, Haipeng Dong, Bei Ding, Huan Zhang
pmc-11651964.description: BackgroundDeep learning has developed rapidly, and deep learning reconstruction (DLR) methods in magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) are gaining attention for their potential to improve efficacy in clinical work. The preoperative MRI assessment of rectal cancer is crucial for patient management, but the imaging quality is currently limited by a number of factors.

pmc-12647115.title: Epigenetic regulation of RNA methylations in gastric cancer
pmc-12647115.creator: Kaijie Liu, Yafeng Liu, Shujun Zhang, Ziang Li, Wenbing Qu, Penghui Li, Xinjun Hu
pmc-12647115.description: Gastric cancer (GC) remains a major global health challenge due to its high incidence and mortality. Emerging evidence underscores the critical role of RNA methylation, a key layer of epigenetic regulation, in GC pathogenesis. This review synthesizes current knowledge on various RNA modifications, including m6A, m5C, m1A, and m7G, in GC.

pmc-13086663.title: Physicians’ ethical responsibilities in relation to the climate and further environmental crises: a review of academic publications
pmc-13086663.creator: Cristian Timmermann, Katharina J. Pascale Wabnitz, Kerstin Schlögl-Flierl, Verina Wild
pmc-13086663.description: The climate and further environmental crises have motivated calls for the medical profession to act by taking on additional responsibilities. These calls to assume responsibilities towards environmental protection and to systematically consider the health impacts of these crises greatly vary in their scope and demandingness.

pmc-13172443.title: Integrated transcriptomic and metabolomic analyses reveal the regulatory network underlying NtGSTU10-mediated nicotine synthesis and transport in tobacco
pmc-13172443.creator: Yudan Zhou, Yuanfei Lou, Min Xie, Kai Pi, Zejun Mo, Chenhao Shi, Junting Zhang, Renxiang Liu, Qiwei Yu
pmc-13172443.description: Nicotine is the major alkaloid in tobacco and plays a key role in determining tobacco quality. Previous studies have shown that overexpression of NtGSTU10 enhances nicotine accumulation in tobacco hybrids; however, the molecular mechanisms underlying this process remain largely unclear.

pmc-13411915.title: Study of Cytotoxicity of Pyrrolo[3,4-d]isoxazoline and Pyrrolo[2,1-a]isoquinoline Derivatives Against Tumor Cell Lines
pmc-13411915.creator: Andrew S. Drachuk, Sergey S. Mkrtchan, Stanislav V. Shmakov, Sergey Yu. Vyazmin, Kristina A. Kim, Alexander V. Stepakov, Vitali M. Boitsov
pmc-13411915.description: Antiproliferative activity of pyrrolo[3,4-d]isoxazolines and pyrrolo[2,1-a]isoquinolines derived from them was studied against human erythroleukemia (K562), cervical carcinoma (HeLa), and melanoma (Sk-mel-2) cell lines in vitro by MTS assays followed by study of their effect on actin cytoskeleton and cell motility by confocal microscopy, and apoptotic activity by flow cytometry.

pmc-13473960.title: Evaluation of a universal 3-4 month Healthy Child Programme visit in a local area of England: a mixed methods study
pmc-13473960.creator: Nathan Davies, Denise Kendrick, Jessica Eve Jackson, Elizabeth Orton, Miriam Avery, Jo Leonardi-Bee, Hayden Bird, Holly Knight

pmc-13492406.title: Refining the Prognostic Interpretation of Myocardial PD-L1 Expression in ICI-Associated Myocarditis
pmc-13492406.creator: Shangxuan Li, Yi Wang, Zekai Yu, Lu Yin, Dianyuan Li
pmc-13492406.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). This work provides valuable tissue-level evidence for risk stratification in a rare but potentially fatal cardiovascular complication. However, 2 issues may benefit from further clarification. First, the prognostic value of the 8% PD-L1 cutoff requires cautious interpretation. Although the threshold was derived by receiver operating characteristic analysis and supported by an alternative log-rank approach, the cohort included only 20 patients and 6 events.1 Such a small event number may make cutoff selection vulnerable to optimism and event-driven instability.

pmc-13566781.title: A Single-Cell Transcriptional Landscape of Emphysema: Heterogeneous Cellular Dynamics in Centrilobular, Panlobular, and Paraseptal Subtypes
pmc-13566781.creator: Wei-Ping Hu, Jian-Cheng Zhu, Li Liu, Yi-Xing Wu, Jie Wang, Jing Zhang
pmc-13566781.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Emphysema is a chronic lung disease characterized by irreversible alveolar destruction, with distinct imaging subtypes—centrilobular emphysema (CLE), panlobular emphysema (PLE), and paraseptal emphysema (PSE). The cellular and molecular mechanisms driving subtype-specific pathogenesis remain poorly understood. Here, we performed single-cell RNA sequencing on emphysematous lung tissues from nine patients (three per subtype) to map the transcriptional landscape across CLE, PLE, and PSE. Profiling 84,704 high-quality cells, we identified eight major cell types, and subsequent subclustering uncovered subtype-enriched populations and transcriptional features.

pmc-13612790.title: β-Hydroxybutyrate Exposure is Associated with Increased TH+ Neuron Abundance and Dopaminergic-Related Transcriptional Features in Human Midbrain Organoids
pmc-13612790.creator: Juan Jair Santillán-Cigales, Cesar Meléndez-Ramírez, Margareht Reyes-Aldana, Itzel Escobedo-Avila, Maricela Cabrera-Castro, Alejandro López-Saavedra, Raquel Cuevas-Diaz Duran, Iván Velasco
pmc-13612790.description: Neuronal differentiation is a highly regulated process in which morphogens establish cellular identities through coordinated transcriptional programs. However, the contribution of physiologically derived metabolites to human neural development remains poorly understood. β-hydroxybutyrate (bhb) has been recognized as an inflammatory, epigenetic, energetic, and neuroprotective regulator.

pmc-13700286.title: Online EMG onset detection during sit-to-stand motion using the time derivative of sample entropy
pmc-13700286.creator: Louise Scherrer, Abderrahmane Kheddar, Gauthier Desmyttere, Gilles Dusfour, Christian Jorgensen, Sofiane Ramdani
pmc-13700286.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundLow-latency detection of muscle activation onset is essential for online movement analysis and for many assistive and rehabilitation applications, enabling early inference of user motion intent. Surface electromyography (sEMG) are promising signals for this purpose. However, prior work has highlighted that designing robust online sEMG onset detectors remains challenging due to substantial inter- and intra-subject variability, and many approaches are primarily evaluated offline, limiting their applicability in real-world settings.

uslaw-usc-t16-s1533.title: 16 U.S.C. § 1533 — Determination of endangered species and threatened species
uslaw-usc-t16-s1533.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t16-s1533.description: United States Code, Title 16 (Conservation); Chapter 35 (Endangered Species). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Generally (1) The Secretary shall by regulation promulgated in accordance with subsection (b) determine whether any species is an endangered species or a threatened species because of any of the following factors: (A) the present or threatened destruction, modification, or curtailment of its habitat or range.
